ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low; high-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 15% of the total visible ventral surface area against an 85% low-intensity (black) background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips. Left distal tip shows a contiguous white region with internal black focal spots. Right distal tip shows a fragmented mottled white-on-black pattern. The axial and mid-lobe regions are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 115 degrees and a vertical depth relative to lobe height of approximately 6%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) distributed continuously along the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips, showing higher irregularity on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges exhibit a linear sweep with a moderate convex curvature at the outer distal transition points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (diameter 2-8 pixels) distributed across the dark central and right lobe regions, consistent with sessile organism attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are detectable on the right lobe surface, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized circular depigmented scars distributed across both lobes; significant jagged indentation and loss of continuous contour on the far-left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in white pigmentation density between the far-left and far-right distal regions.
